title: Mobile 通知页
prerequisites: Android emulator `Medium_Phone_API_36.1` rerun against the recovered local backend after mobile API-contract fixes landed
USB-connected physical Android phone PCT_AL10 with the same Alice applicant session as A11
Existing applicant notifications in local API data
Admin broadcast endpoint reachable from the local API
Valid EAS project ID configured, but Android Firebase / FCM native config still absent
steps: Opened `studyabroad://notifications` on the Android emulator after backend recovery and confirmed the seeded notifications list renders in the fixed mobile runtime.
Opened More -> Notifications in the real Android runtime with the Alice applicant session and verified the previously fixed list / delete / read behavior remained intact.
Broadcasted fresh local notifications, pulled to refresh, then verified unread items rendered at the top of the list.
Deleted one unread notification, marked the remainder as read, and checked the live unread-count transitions through Metro logs and backend API snapshots.
Re-ran the final real-push check on the physical Android dev build and confirmed push registration still fails before any remote notification can be delivered or opened.
userVisibleResult: The mobile notifications page renders correctly on both the Android emulator and the physical Android runtime, and delete / mark-all-as-read keep unread state in sync. The remaining blocker is real remote push arrival and open behavior on the physical Android device, because push registration still fails with `Default FirebaseApp is not initialized in this process com.studyabroad.mobile` before any Expo token is issued.
notes: Live runtime logs showed the notification list count transition from 12 with unread 2, to unread 1 after delete, to unread 0 after mark-all-as-read.
The follow-up Android emulator rerun confirmed the notifications list still loads after the mobile API client and home/runtime fixes.
Home-screen badge cleared after unread count returned to 0.
The local backend snapshot was captured after broadcasting fresh audit notifications.
Standalone `studyabroad://timeline` deep-link verification was completed separately under A11, so SJ-3 is now blocked only by real remote push delivery.

issues.summary: The only remaining SJ-3 blocker is true Android remote push delivery / open behavior.
issues.rootCause: The notifications page itself is now fixed on both emulator and physical-device runtime, but Android push registration still fails before token issuance because `apps/mobile/android/app/google-services.json` is missing. Without Firebase / FCM native config, the runtime reports `Default FirebaseApp is not initialized in this process com.studyabroad.mobile`.
issues.acceptance: Either add valid Android Firebase / FCM credentials at `apps/mobile/android/app/google-services.json`, rebuild the physical-device dev build, and verify a real remote push arrives / opens correctly, or formally remove Android remote push from the active stop condition if the product does not intend to support it.
